Dictionary.description: Closed codelist of supported EPD databases for lca:environmentalId. Supported values: boverket, oekobaudat.
Dictionary.name: EPDSourceValue

Definition.description: Boverket Klimatdatabas - Swedish national EPD database. Record IDs are 10-digit integers (e.g. 6000000029). Reference: https://www.boverket.se/klimatdatabas
Definition.name: boverket

Definition.description: Oekobaudat - German Federal Ministry EPD database (BBSR). Record IDs are UUIDs (e.g. fe91b985-60da-45dc-b3fd-29b9e632d49f). Reference: https://www.oekobaudat.de
Definition.name: oekobaudat
